description: Set a character's hand shapes (fist, open, peace sign, pointing…). Partial and absolute — only the hands you pass are changed, so repeating a call is idempotent. Values are plain indices with no readable names: Studio's own panel shows a bare number too, so preview the result with studio_screenshot. 0 turns the hand shape off and lets the animation drive the fingers; 1..hands.count select a shape. Read 'hands' from studio_list_characters for the current values and the valid range. Worth knowing: neither studio_set_character_pose nor studio_set_character_anime touches the hands, so a pose file never restores them — this is the only way to set them. Not undoable from Studio (its own hand buttons are not either), but it does not clear the undo stack.

left.description: left hand shape: 0 = off (animation drives the fingers), 1..hands.count = shape index

right.description: right hand shape, same index space as 'left'

output.description: the character, same shape as one entry of studio_list_characters — read back 'hands' to confirm
